intro: What we know, what we don't, and how to close each gap before a decision is made. 'Answered' items cite a source. 'Open' items list how to find the answer.

questions.question: What exact wording must the Associates identification statement use?
questions.answer: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.” (or substantially similar wording).

questions.question: Which rel value should affiliate links carry?
questions.answer: rel="sponsored" for paid links; nofollow is an acceptable alternative.

questions.question: Must the affiliate disclosure be clear and conspicuous?
questions.answer: Yes. Material connections must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously (16 CFR 255.5).

questions.question: What ASIN or full listing URL does each of the five supplied links correspond to?
questions.answer: Not determined. Tokens are 9 characters; destinations differ from tokens for P-01 and P-02; no product for P-03..P-05.
questions.how_to_close: Owner opens each link in a normal browser and records the final URL, or supplies the ASIN/listing URL for each product.

questions.question: Is the official ASIN length rule (10 characters) confirmed by Amazon?
questions.answer: Only third-party sources were found. An official Amazon definition was not located.
questions.how_to_close: Find the Amazon Seller Central or Associates help page that defines ASIN, and link it.

questions.question: Are the short links generated under the enrolled Associates account with tracking ID shopnow047c-20?
questions.how_to_close: In Associates, open the Link Builder or link details for each link and confirm the tag.

questions.question: Do the short links breach Program Policies §2(e) (redirecting) or §2(g) (improperly formatted)?
questions.answer: Not determined. Not claimed to be invalid.
questions.how_to_close: Run the one-link-per-product Special Link test; if unclear, ask Associates support.

questions.question: Will organic search traffic produce commissions, given §2(d)?
questions.answer: Not determined. Depends on how the referral route works.
questions.how_to_close: Ask Associates support; watch the first 90 days of Associates reports before scaling SEO.

questions.question: What is each product's current price, availability, and rating?
questions.answer: Not captured for the main products (F-08).
questions.how_to_close: Capture from each confirmed listing with a timestamp; never copy carousel values.

questions.question: Which five events should be recorded?
questions.answer: Not defined in the brief. A proposed set exists (Suggestions S-07).
questions.how_to_close: Owner picks or edits the set.

questions.question: Where will analytics events be sent?
questions.answer: No endpoint exists yet. GitHub Pages cannot receive events.

questions.question: What brand name and domain should the site use?
questions.answer: Not decided. The repo name 'Affil2' is used as a working name. A working brand is proposed on the Suggestions page.

questions.question: What publishing cadence should be used?
Are the four editorial working titles approved for publication?
questions.answer: Not approved. They are hypotheses, not claims about popularity or quality.
questions.how_to_close: Owner approves or changes the list (Suggestions S-06).

questions.question: Can Amazon product images be used on the site?
questions.answer: Not checked. The IP License section was not read.
questions.how_to_close: Read the Program Policies IP License section and decide (Suggestions S-09).

questions.question: Which owner account will verify Search Console and submit the sitemap?
Is the source register referenced in the brief (S01–S30, SG-27..SG-30, FLG-003) available?
questions.how_to_close: Add the register file to the repo.

questions.question: Do the campaign ledger figures exist?
questions.answer: No. The ledger is empty. Rows may be added only from authorized first-party reports.
questions.how_to_close: Import Associates reports with provenance notes.

questions.question: Is GitHub Pages enabled for this repo, and at what URL?
questions.answer: Expected URL is https://karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil2/ (set during integration; confirmed only if the deploy succeeds).
